title: Replying to an old postcard
titleZh: 寫一張回覆老明信片的卡片
passage: Welcome to Postcard Day. The cards on the wall are copies of short notes that people sent from this neighbourhood years ago. Pick one to read, then write an imaginary reply on a blank card from the table. Please leave the old notes on the wall so the next person can choose from the same set. The sample on the table has a park bench drawn in the address box. We’re not posting the replies. Put a place from the old note in that box, such as the bakery or the station. It helps people tell which note your reply is for. You can take your reply home. If you want to leave it on display, slide it into the clear pocket under the note you picked.
passageZh: 歡迎來到明信片活動。牆上的卡片是多年前有人從這個社區寄出的短箋複本。選一張來讀，再從桌上拿張空白卡，寫下想像中的回覆。請把舊短箋留在牆上，下一位也才能從同一組挑選。 桌上的範例在地址欄畫了一張公園長椅。我們不會把回覆寄出去。請在那個欄位填入舊短箋提到的某個地方，例如麵包店或車站。這能讓別人看出你是回覆哪張短箋。 你可以把自己的回覆帶回家。如果想留下來展示，就把它滑進你選的那張短箋下方的透明袋。
